title: VMware ESXi and an overview of Hyper-V

videos.script: Two names come up in almost every company with servers. VMware ESXi, in the server room. And Hyper-V, which is in Windows already. {{names}} ESXi is a type 1 hypervisor in the purest form. The server boots into it, it shows a yellow and grey screen with an address, and everything else happens from a browser. {{esxi}} Hyper-V comes with Windows Pro and with Windows Server. Switch it on, and Windows itself becomes a guest of it, as lesson 2 said. {{hyperv}} Neither can run on the computer this course is recorded on, so nothing in this lesson was run. What you will get instead is the vocabulary. Every hypervisor has a disk format, a settings file, an agent, a word for snapshot and a set of networks. Once you know one, the others are a table. {{table}}
